question: List concert names and the locations of the stadiums where they took place at Somerset Park.
reference_sql: SELECT c.concert_Name, s.Location FROM concert AS c JOIN stadium AS s ON c.Stadium_ID = CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR) WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park'
candidate_sql:
SELECT c.concert_Name, s.Location
FROM concert AS c
JOIN stadium AS s
  ON c.Stadium_ID = CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR)
WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park';
